lines.speaker: spirit
lines.text: Ooooh... a living soul. It has been a long time since anyone wandered down here.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Who are you? And why is everything suddenly so quiet?

lines.speaker: spirit
lines.text: While we talk, the dungeon holds its breath. Nothing moves, nothing attacks. Press SPACE to keep listening.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Hehe, don't mind me! Speaking of which... care to buy something once the world starts moving again?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Maybe later. Let's get out of here first.
